title: Migrator-leg phUSD bank strand: story-031's phUSD bank is unreachable when the beneficiary is MigratorV2V3, and is unrecoverable by ANY on-chain mechanism
description: story-031's phUSD bank credits unclaimablePhUSDOf[beneficiary] when the mint leg fails. When the beneficiary is the MigratorV2V3 CONTRACT, the bank is unreachable: MigratorV2V3's complete external surface (seedUsers:144, migrate:172, migrateOne:235, skipCurrent:284, claimUnclaimable:302, withdrawAll:318, userCount:370) reaches no PhlimboV3.claimUnclaimablePhUSD(). Uniquely among the three banks, it is also unrecoverable by the owner's emergencyTransfer sweep -- because the phUSD was never minted, there is no balance to sweep.
impact: One migrating user's accrued phUSD REWARD entitlement for a single position. NOT principal. Nothing was minted, so the protocol balance sheet is untouched: no dilution, no other user harmed.
attackPath: No attacker, no permissionless trigger, nobody profits. A triple-gated operational/ABI gap.
gating: (1) non-zero desiredAPYBps -- NOT SHIPPED. :60 is uninitialized => 0, and the leg is guarded by `if (pendingPhUSDAmount > 0)` at :903, so the path is DEAD CODE today.
(2) an INDIVIDUAL phUSD mint-authority outage (a global revoke self-heals loudly via UserMigrationFailed).
(3) the beneficiary is the MigratorV2V3 contract rather than an EOA.
recommendation: Add a forwarder on MigratorV2V3 that calls PhlimboV3.claimUnclaimablePhUSD for itself. See CRITICAL_FIX_NOTE -- this must be fixed TOGETHER with V3-L-15, not by V3-L-15's text as written.
CRITICAL_FIX_NOTE: V3-L-15's recommendation as written ('add a forwarder that calls claimUnclaimableStable/Promo') closes the stable and promo banks and would LEAVE THE phUSD BANK STRANDED -- an incomplete fix that reads as done, the failure mode ranked second only to a regression. Fixing V3-L-15 as written does NOT fix this finding. V3-L-15's recommendation is PROPOSED for widening to also cover claimUnclaimablePhUSD.

ownerIdentityResolution.question: Is PhlimboV3's owner the same party as FlaxToken's owner? The classifier called this 'the highest-value open question in this run', 'not answerable from the repo', and made it the SINGLE load-bearing prop under this Low. It is ALSO the standing humanTriageQuestion on ledger entry V3-M-07 (open since run-10).
ownerIdentityResolution.verdict: ANSWERED -- SAME PARTY, for every Phlimbo generation actually deployed. Proven by EXECUTED MAINNET TRANSACTIONS, not by reading intent.
evidence: lib/phoenix-phase-2-staging/broadcast/MigratePhlimboV1ToV2.s.sol/1/run-latest.json -- 15 transactions, ALL from EOA 0xcad1a7864a108dbff67f4b8af71fab0c7a86d0b6, ALL receipts status 0x1. That single sender successfully executed, in ONE run: setMinter(address,bool) x2 on phUSD 0xf3b5b661...cd605 (setMinter is onlyOwner on FlaxToken), emergencyTransfer(address) on PhlimboEA V1 (onlyOwner), and setMigrator + setPauser on PhlimboV2 (onlyOwner). Since the FlaxToken onlyOwner call SUCCEEDED from that address, it WAS phUSD's owner at that block; since the Phlimbo onlyOwner calls succeeded from the same address in the same run, it is also Phlimbo's owner. One EOA holds both roles. These txs landed -- settled state, not intent.

THE OWNER HAS ALREADY EXERCISED THIS FINDING'S EXACT REMEDY ON MAINNET: broadcast/MintAndSellPhUSDToDeployer.s.sol/1/run-latest.json and MintBuyAndBurnUSDS.s.sol/1/run-latest.json both show 0xcad1a... calling mint(address,uint256) directly on phUSD, status 0x1. Source path at script/MintAndSellPhUSDToDeployer.s.sol:292-294: `if (!ph.authorizedMinters(OWNER).canMint) { ph.setMinter(OWNER, true); } ph.mint(address(helper), q.phusdIn);` -- exactly the setMinter(owner,true)+mint(user,amount) sequence the classifier could only verify as theoretically open.

script/MigratePhlimboV1ToV2.s.sol:273 -- `require(ownerOnChain == OWNER_ADDRESS, ...)` with OWNER_ADDRESS = 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 (:80); both emergencyTransfer (:324) and PHUSD.setMinter (:412) run inside ONE vm.startBroadcast() (:173).
transferOwnership count across phStaging script/ scripts/ src/ server/: 0. No Safe/multisig/timelock governs these roles; script comments call 0xCad1a... the 'Owner (ledger signer)'.

FlaxToken re-confirmed (8 vendored copies byte-identical, md5 2969103392d9b02af2b2710f80f8db45): mint :58-69 is minter-gated NOT onlyOwner; setMinter :44 is onlyOwner; revokeAllMintPrivileges :88-91 only does `mintVersion++` -- it does NOT clear _authorizedMinters and is fully reversible via setMinter. A soft reset, NOT a one-way supply lock.
ownerIdentityResolution.effect: Low CONFIRMED on a materially FIRMER footing than the classifier believed. Confidence raised from 'the entire Low rests on an unanswerable question' to HIGH.
ownerIdentityResolution.residual: PhlimboV3 is UNDEPLOYED -- zero references anywhere in phoenix-phase-2-staging (full untruncated grep). So same-owner for V3 is an evidence-backed PROJECTION, not a settled fact. It reduces to a ONE-LINE DEPLOY-TIME RUNBOOK CHECK: confirm PhlimboV3's owner also holds phUSD mint authority before deploy.
ownerIdentityResolution.closesLedgerQuestion: This ALSO closes V3-M-07's standing run-10 humanTriageQuestion and VINDICATES the owner's wont-fix reasoning on it.

MR_11_005_DISCLOSURE.obligation: MANDATORY disclosure block -- attached per the standing project rule 'Disclose when re-filing an owner wont-fix'.
MR_11_005_DISCLOSURE.quotedTriageReason: 'Owner-trust / Law-3: the trigger (:863 phUSD mint-authorization revocation) is controlled by the same principals who control PhlimboV3. Revoking mint rights would freeze principal, but that is a self-inflicted "cutting off nose to spite the face" action -- at worst a temporary, owner-reversible misconfiguration, not an external attack vector.'
MR_11_005_DISCLOSURE.whyThePrecedentDoesNotExtend: V3-M-07's wont-fix rationale rests on the property 'fully recoverable -- re-grant mint role or emergencyTransfer'. That is PRECISELY the property story-031 BROKE on the migrator leg: the banked phUSD is now recoverable by NEITHER mechanism (re-granting mint does not help -- the bank has no puller; emergencyTransfer cannot sweep tokens that were never minted). A wont-fix precedent whose load-bearing property has been invalidated by a later change is a LIVE SUPPRESSION RISK.
MR_11_005_DISCLOSURE.warning: A future run could reasonably reach for V3-M-07's wont-fix as grounds to suppress this finding, and WOULD BE WRONG. Do not.
MR_11_005_DISCLOSURE.reFileBasis: New contract leg (MigratorV2V3 beneficiary), new fingerprint that dedup will not flag against V3-M-07, and the precedent's load-bearing property no longer holds on this leg.

severityRationale: Low CONFIRMED by severity-auditor (high confidence). Not Medium: no principal at risk, nothing minted (balance sheet untouched), no attacker, no permissionless trigger, triple-gated, and the reward stream is OFF at the shipped config. The classifier's dissent was read and adjudicated.
escalationTriggers: Any non-zero desiredAPYBps -- this finding comes ALIVE with the stream (see DEDUP-04 annotation) and MUST be re-weighed alongside L-02 and Q-02.

If MR-11-001 (63/64 gas-rule OOG forcing the bank) is ever established, it removes the mint-authority-outage precondition entirely, converting this triple-gated Low into something reachable without any owner action. Parked, not dropped.

doNotCollapse.V3-L-15: MUST remain SEPARATE. V3-L-15's Low rests on 'value is NOT lost (owner emergencyTransfer sweeps it)', which is TOKEN-SPECIFIC and PROVABLY FALSE for the un-minted phUSD bank (PoC: the bank survives emergencyTransfer untouched).
doNotCollapse.DEDUP-04: Different root cause. DEDUP-04 is phUSD UNCAPPED-mint OVER-emission (unbacked dilution); this is a phUSD bank STRAND. Shared dormancy is NOT shared root cause.
